title: Fourier coefficients under the vector space duality
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$. For every $\gamma\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at the linear functional $x\mapsto\sum_{i=1}^n\gamma_i x_i$ equals the vector Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $\gamma$.
hypotheses_covered: The ambient vector space $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ is finite-dimensional over $\mathbb{F}_2$
